title: University of Graz Scholarships for International Students
program_type: University funding hub: faculty merit-based scholarships plus national support schemes
duration: assessment period 1 October 2025 to 30 September 2026 (academic year 2025/26); the award itself is a one-off payment
description: The University of Graz points students to national support schemes such as the study grant and family allowance, and offers faculty-allocated merit-based scholarships for outstanding academic results, with eligibility limited to Austrian citizens, EEA citizens, stateless persons and refugees as defined in the Student Support Act.

title: University of Innsbruck Scholarships for International Students
program_type: University-administered performance-based and thesis scholarships under StudFG
duration: One-off payment, not a recurring stipend; performance-based scholarships are awarded for one academic year based on the previous year's examinations (01 October - 30 September).
description: The University of Innsbruck awards performance-based scholarships under Section 57 of the Austrian Student Support Act and scholarships for scientific theses, both applied for through the LFU:online platform, with faculty-specific ECTS minimums and grade thresholds published in the call.

title: Johannes Kepler University Linz (JKU) Scholarships
program_type: University scholarship hub: merit scholarships, study grants, refugee and diversity awards
duration: One-off lump-sum payment; scholarships are awarded annually.
description: JKU Linz awards merit scholarships of EUR 750 to 1,500 as a single lump sum for outstanding achievement and study grants of EUR 750 to 3,600 for unfinished theses, alongside the Borealis-MORE scholarship for refugee students and the IRIS FISCHLMAYR awards, with applications submitted through the university's online portal.

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees — Austria-based
degree: Master's (2 years, joint degree, 2+ EU countries including Austria)
program_type: EU-funded joint master's scholarship (Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters, Erasmus+ Key Action 2)
duration: 1 to 2 academic years (60, 90 or 120 ECTS credits)
description: Funded Master's degrees from Erasmus Mundus.

title: CEU Scholarships (Central European University) — Vienna
program_type: University institutional financial aid (tuition awards and stipends) plus donor-funded scholarships
duration: Master's programmes of 1 or 2 years; the doctoral stipend is awarded for 48 months in total
description: CEU awards financial aid on academic merit across its bachelor, master and doctoral programmes in Vienna. At doctoral level the CEU Doctoral Scholarship covers the full cost of tuition together with a monthly stipend for housing and living costs, while master's support combines a tuition award with a smaller monthly stipend and bachelor support takes the form of partial tuition awards.

title: Webster University Vienna Scholarships
duration: Awarded for one academic year and renewable for the full duration of the academic program, up to a maximum of four years for undergraduate study and up to two years for graduate study.
description: Webster Vienna Private University offers the WVPU New Student Scholarship, a partial tuition award in three tiered levels for newly admitted bachelor's and master's degree students, on the basis of both academic achievement and financial need. Up to 20 awards are made per year at EUR 12,000/7,000/4,000 per academic year for bachelor's degrees and EUR 8,000/5,000/3,000 for master's degrees. The university states explicitly that these are partial scholarships and that the recipient must pay the remaining tuition fee. title: Modul University Vienna Scholarships
program_type: Private university tuition reductions and grants (plus an externally funded government mobility scholarship)
duration: Reductions apply per semester or per academic year as stated; the Alumni and Exchange Alumni grants run for the duration of the continuing programme
description: Modul University Vienna publishes a portfolio of tuition-fee reductions and grants rather than a single cash scholarship. These include deadline-linked Early Bird discounts, sibling and advance-payment discounts, and GPA-band grants for MU alumni, valedictorians and exchange alumni.
